-- Returns the last element of xs, or None when xs is empty.
last_of(xs: List[str]) -> str? =
  ex last_of(["a", "b"]) == "b"
  ex last_of([]) == None
  if xs.len() == 0
    return None
  xs.get(xs.len() - 1)

-- Appends a copy of s to the borrowed list dst, editing it in place.
add_name(var dst: List[str], s: str) =
  pre dst.len() >= 0
  post last_of(dst) == s
  post dst.len() >= 1
  dst.append(copy s)
